html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
 
The enraged retaliator of hell and the Hydra has returned to MARVEL Future Fight!
 
Ghost Rider, who has acquired a new Uniform and Tier-4 Advancement,
will judge his enemies with the endless flames of hellfire.
 
Sin, who has acquired a new Uniform and Tier-3 Advancement,
will show the fury of Hydra.
 
Agents, check out the new skills and power of the updated heroes
by downloading the 10/17 Patch!
 
■ 10/17 Patch Details
 
Patch Schedule: 10/18 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 10/17 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)
 

[10/18 (Wed) 3:11 (UTC+0), 10/17 (Tue) 20:11 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 10/18 (Wed) 3:08 (UTC+0), 10/17 (Tue) 20:08 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.
 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms
 
Two new Uniforms Ghost Rider <Rage Returned> and Sin <Rage Returned> have been added.

 

* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 10/17 Patch data has been applied.
* The new Uniforms can be purchased during the event period.
▶ Ghost Rider <Rage Returned>: 
After the 10/17 Patch - 10/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0), After the 10/17 Patch - 10/31 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase method: Crystal purchase (Discount events will not be applied.)
▶ Sin <Rage Returned>: 
After the 10/17 Patch - 11/3 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0), After the 10/17 Patch - 11/3 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase method: Can be exchanged at the Event Shop with Revenge Tokens
- Revenge Tokens can be acquired by purchasing event products or more until 

10/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0), 10/31 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT).
* Season Uniforms may be available again after the event has ended through similar events or packages.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)  
 

 

 


▣ Ghost Rider Tier-4
 
Ghost Rider is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
The endless flames will make the retaliate of hell even stronger.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.
 

 


▣ Sin Tier-3
 
Sin is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Check out the new looks of Sin who has become stronger to restore Hydra.

 

 


 
▣ New Artifact
 
New Artifacts for Ghost Rider and Sin have been added.
* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill Lv.4 stats.
 


 
▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. Some texts in the character achievement of Doctor Voodoo have been fixed to be displayed normally.

 

2. Some text of the Fortitude effect being wrongly displayed has been fixed.
- Only the text has been wrongly displayed and the effects were being activated normally.
Before: when HP is below x%
After: when HP is x% or below
 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.

 

Thank you.
